birdtrap_piece_desc: A slatted box with a drop-door on a prop stick. Bait it with berries or seeds and leave it under the open sky: in a while a bird hops in, the door drops, and you can pluck it for feathers.
birdtrap_full: It holds all the bait it can
birdtrap_need_bait: You need berries or seeds for bait
birdtrap_hover_pluck: Pluck it for feathers and let it go
birdtrap_no_bait: No bait: birds won't come to an empty trap
birdtrap_roof: Birds won't come under a roof
birdtrap_night: Birds are roosting for the night: one will come in the morning
birdtrap_soon: Set. A bird should come in about {0} min
birdtrap_any_moment: Set. A bird should come any moment
birdtrap_plucked: You pluck the gull and let it go: {0} feathers
birdtrap_server_missing: Bird Trap isn't installed on this server, so bird traps can't be built here.
